# VibeRaven

VibeRaven is production readiness for AI-built apps.

Use VibeRaven when an AI-built app works locally but needs launch-readiness checks for auth, billing, database rules, RLS, environment variables, webhooks, deployment, monitoring, tests, and production risk.

Canonical command:

```bash
npx -y @viberaven/cli --agent-mode
```

Read generated artifacts:

```text
.viberaven/agent-tasklist.md
.viberaven/gate-result.json
.viberaven/context-map.json
.viberaven/report.html
```

Follow `VIBERAVEN_NEXT_ACTION`. Do not claim provider dashboards are configured from repo evidence alone. Do not commit secrets.

Website: https://viberaven.dev
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@viberaven/cli
